claim_summary: For the ordinary matching complex of the icosahedral graph, the 64-dimensional rational third-homology representation of A5 x C2 is (2V4+4V5+2V6)^+ plus (2V4+2V5+V6)^-; the unique integral Z/3 torsion group in third homology carries the antipodal sign character. The nonequivariant homotopy type is previously known.
scientific_integrity: Every automorphism action and finite chain computation can be recomputed from the independent standalone scientific verifier; finite exhaustive verification and literature inspection are not an external audit.
scientific_limitations: A single finite graph; no determination of the integral lattice structure on the free rank-64 summand, of an equivariant homotopy type, or of arbitrary matching complexes. The published nonequivariant result is context, not asserted as novel. Unindexed equivalent equivariant work cannot be excluded.
title: Antipodal-odd three-torsion and the complete rational icosahedral action on matching-complex homology
